choices.frozen: Byte-exact 946 solver16 with the usual field-valued H query.
choices.ordinary: Current executable, with the unchanged field-valued emission and H path.
choices.scalar: Convert final emitted H coefficients to canonical form using scalar arithmetic.
choices.packed: Use packed IFMA reduction and canonical export at emission.

calibration: Absolute paired median within 2% of frozen on each input.
qualification: Lower paired median and at least nine of twelve wins against both controls on both public inputs. Prefer packed to scalar using the same incremental threshold when both qualify.
correctness: Fixed wires and matching public inputs, fresh external Gnark verification for each exported proof.
